entities.name: Mirko Peters

entities.name: Dynamics 365
entities.quote: Dynamics 365 OmniChannel pulls those conversations into one workspace.

entities.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
entities.quote: So you owe them the setup OmniChannel for customer service.

quotes.text: Each channel feels like walking into a different branch of the same company where no one has seen the notes from the branch you just left.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures the customer pain of disconnected support channels in one image.

quotes.text: This doesn't mean every conversation connects by magic. The company still has to set up channels correctly, link records, and decide what information to collect.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sets realistic expectations about what omnichannel requires.

quotes.text: A consult brings another person into the work without taking the customer out of the conversation.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the difference between a consult and a transfer in one sentence.

quotes.text: Still, suggestions are suggestions. An agent needs to check the article, read the summary, and make sure any suggested response is accurate before sending it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear guidance that people remain responsible for AI-assisted answers.

quotes.text: The agent should treat sentiment as a prompt to listen more carefully, not as a label that explains the person.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Thoughtful advice on interpreting sentiment signals.

chapters.title: Why separate channels create bad support

takeaways: Dynamics 365 Omnichannel brings chat, voice, SMS and social conversations into one agent workspace with the customer's history beside them.
Routing uses queues, rules, skills, presence and capacity to send each request to the right available person, and consults avoid needless transfers.
Context only follows the customer when channels are set up correctly and conversations are linked to the right contact or case.
hook: Customers repeat their story on every channel because chat, email, phone and social messages live in separate tools. This episode explains for customer service teams and supervisors how Dynamics 365 Omnichannel connects those conversations in one workspace. You will learn how routing, agent tools, customer history and real-time dashboards fit together.
